pages.title: Thread Moon
pages.text: A moon wound with rose-coloured thread.

Teammates (teams are set by the server with $(o)/moonteams$()) within 12 blocks with a clear line of sight are $(l)bonded$(). Each bonded teammate gives 5% damage reduction, up to 15%. A thin thread links you, and "Thread bond" shows by the hotbar.
Separate and the bonus fades over 3 seconds.$(br2)$(l)Not reduced:$() fall, fire, lava, drowning, starvation, magic, wither and the void. Only your team sees your threads; pets and mobs never bond.
